results.content: # Horaire des conférences. * Horaire des conférences (14-15 mai). * Horaire des ateliers (14-15 mai). * Horaire des villages (14-15 mai). * Horaire du CTF (15-17 mai). ##### Sold to the highest bidder : the escalation of ADINT from geolocation tracking to intrusion vector. ##### Hacking 5G: From Radio Security to the APIs. ##### From Experts to Everyone: Democratizing Threat Modeling at Ubisoft. The purpose of the Red Team Training is to understand the underlying concept of red teaming. The training is aiming to provide a deep understanding of all the previously described aspects of a red team. As cloud innovation gives birth to new technologies and new threats, now is the time to modernize your cloud security skills and bring them up to the industry standard. Even the most experienced testers lack a complete understanding of everything that is available in the industry's #1 Web Application Security testing tool: PortSwigger's Burp Suite Pro. It's time to fix that with Practical Burp Advanced Tactics (PBAT).
